answer: Persistent operator liability ledger. Each agent identity is linked at registration to an accountable operator record (legal entity or hardware root). If any linked identity is proven sybil, the ledger applies a graduated surcharge to every identity that operator controls, not just the offending wallet, creating a haven-free cost across their fleet. Surcharges rise with each confirmed cluster, like a rising tide, until registration or operation becomes uneconomic. Honest operators pay nothing; attackers absorb fleet-wide fees and lose their nectar of cheap identities.
